items.section: If You Want to Kill Yourself > This human life is the most precious opportunity
claims: Human birth is extraordinarily rare and precious in Buddhist teaching.
Human life is an opportunity to investigate dukkha, cultivate wisdom and love, and attain liberation rather than merely a life that might be worthwhile.
Suicidal despair can radically misprice that opportunity; do not discard it before investigating what human birth affords.
The infographic visually frames human birth as a cosmic jackpot and contrasts the human opportunity with darker conditioned trajectories and hellish states.
